pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: crates/table-runtime/src/actor.rs:629 An Ok(TerminalVerdict::ErrorReported{subtype}) from the engine (e.g. a budget or turn cap) becomes a bare RunState::Failed with no cause, because cause is taken only from Err. The tool's own classification never reaches the audit row or the owner, and a grep of crates/ outside table-engine finds no reader of ErrorReported.

techniques.evidence: crates/table-runtime/src/actor.rs:629 The envelope subtype is flattened to Failed, so the caller cannot branch on it.

crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:281 A run on the deterministic rung carries its own mode label into the snapshot and the run.start audit row. A native start is refused with a named reason when the engine is unavailable (line 216).
crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:372 The run's MCP grant is enabled only after the child-attested Init event, never on host intent alone.
crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:271 Each start mints a fresh run, and no child thread id is stored or passed back.
crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:390 The child acts only through the host's own gated MCP tools, so there is no native approval request to route.
